description: Na₂Ni₂O₅ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share edges with six NiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.23 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.49 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.45 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.48 Å. There are four inequivalent Ni sites. In the first Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra and edges with five NiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-1.93 Å. In the second Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra and edges with five NiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-1.93 Å. In the third Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and edges with four NiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-1.93 Å. In the fourth Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and edges with four NiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-1.95 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Ni atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Ni atoms to form distorted ONa₃Ni₂ square pyramids that share corners with seven ONa₃Ni₂ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramid, edges with six ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramid. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na and three Ni atoms to form distorted ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramids that share corners with eight ONa₃Ni₂ square pyramids, edges with seven ONa₃Ni₂ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramid. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Ni atoms to form ONa₃Ni₂ square pyramids that share corners with eight ONa₃Ni₂ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramid, and edges with seven ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Ni atoms to form ONa₃Ni₂ square pyramids that share corners with seven ONa₃Ni₂ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramid, edges with six ONa₃Ni₂ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramid. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Na and three Ni atoms to form ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramids that share corners with seven ONa₃Ni₂ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramid, edges with seven ONa₃Ni₂ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramid. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Ni atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two Na and three Ni atoms to form ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramids that share corners with six ONa₃Ni₂ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramid, edges with seven ONa₃Ni₂ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramid. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Ni atoms to form ONa₃Ni₂ square pyramids that share corners with seven ONa₃Ni₂ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramid, and edges with seven ONa₃Ni₂ square pyramids. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Ni atoms to form distorted ONa₃Ni₂ square pyramids that share corners with six ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramids, and edges with seven ONa₃Ni₂ square pyramids.
